Our story

Shakthi & Mahesh

Two hometowns, one city, and a conversation neither of us wanted to end.

Shakthi is from Chennai, and Mahesh is from Hyderabad. We met in Seattle. What brought us together was a shared curiosity about AI and technology, and about where it could all take us next. We could talk for hours about ideas — about what was being built and what might be possible — and those conversations quickly became the best part of our days.

We both worked at Amazon in downtown Seattle, so the city was our everyday backdrop — its streets, its skyline, and days spent between meetings and meals out. Seattle wasn’t just where we worked; it became part of our story, the place where two people from different cities found a shared home.

Beyond technology, we discovered a shared appetite for the rest of life: good food, new places, and the joy of exploring — trying somewhere new, tasting something unfamiliar, and turning an ordinary outing into a small adventure. That love of exploring still shapes our happiest time together, and it’s what we’re most looking forward to sharing with you here in Seattle.

  • AI & TechnologyThe conversations that started it all.
  • FoodAlways searching for the next good meal together.
  • Exploring PlacesNew streets, new views, new adventures.

Now, in the city where so much of our story unfolded, we’re beginning our next chapter together, with all of you.
